steps.caption: Starting point: channel 1 plays pattern 1 on steps 1-4 with the notes C, D, E and F (MIDI 60, 62, 64, 65) at velocities 127, 117, 107 and 97, and no masks are set. Turn E1 to open Channel tasks, turn E2 to Masks and press K3, then turn E2 to Note. The value reads X.
With no step held, turn E3 right until the screen reads C3 (MIDI 60). The channel note replaces the pattern's notes, so the MIDI strip shows C3 four times; the velocities stay the pattern's.
Hold step 1 at (1,4), turn E3 right until the screen reads C4 (12 detents) and release the step. The screen goes back to C3, and the loop now starts on C4 (72) before three C3 notes.
Hold step 2 at (2,4), turn E3 right until it reads D4 (14 detents) and release. The MIDI strip shows 72, 74, 60, 60.
Hold step 3 at (3,4), turn E3 right until it reads G4 (19 detents) and release. The MIDI strip shows 72, 74, 79, 60.
Hold step 4 at (4,4), turn E3 right until it reads E4 (16 detents) and release. The melody ends on E4: 72, 74, 79, 76.
Hold step 4 and turn E3 left until it reads D4 (two detents), then release. Only step 4 changed: the phrase now ends 72, 74, 79, 74.
Hold step 4 and turn E3 left two more detents until it reads C4, then release. The phrase ends on the root: 72, 74, 79, 72.

title: Change the ending of a four-note melody
